Lalco Residency
Luxury Service Apartments in Mumbai | Corporate Stay at Lalco Residency
Comfort. Space. Convenience.
The Lalco Residency Lifestyle

Our service apartments in Mumbai are decorated with high-quality, comfortable furniture and equipped with the latest appliances and technology. Experience all of the benefits and convenience of a hotel with all of the warmth, space and comfort of a home away from home in the Heart of Suburban Mumbai, Andheri East.

Why Stay With Lalco Residency?
At Lalco Residency, we aim to make your stay easier and more comfortable. Lalco Residency offers guests the space to live in an entire serviced apartment/flat, not just a hotel room. We offer 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 bedroom flats in Mumbai and every one of our apartments has a full living room, fully equipped kitchen, dining area and at least two full bathrooms. Lalco Residency is also known for its in-house multi-cuisine restaurant Lalco Cafe which offers the best Chicken Makhanwala (and Chicken Makhanwala Pizza) in Mumbai.

24/7 Front Desk & Concierge
Our 24x7 team offers all the services of a 5-star hotel including daily housekeeping and concierge services at our service apartments in Mumbai. We are the top rated serviced apartment near NESCO Mumbai Exhibition Center and Mumbai Airport.

Our Amenities (home)
Lalco Residency has a Club House that offers 5-star hotel-like amenities. Our Amenities include a swimming pool, a gym, a squash and badminton court, a yoga room, a table tennis room and multiple conference rooms for meetings and a banquet hall.

Home amenities copy
Swimming Pool: Take a dip in the pool to wash away the stress of a tiring day. Guests can enjoy swimming from morning to evening, except on Mondays.
Gym: LR has a fully equipped gym available to our guests 6 days a week. Whether you are looking for a cardio or muscle workout, we’ve got the equipment for you.
Conference Rooms: Lalco Residency has 3 Conference Rooms, a 4-seater, a 6-seater and an 8-seater. Conference Room bookings can be customized to include a variety of set ups and food options.
Squash Court: At LR you play squash at the clubhouse. If you forget your racket or are missing a squash ball, just stop by our front desk and borrow what you need.
Yoga Room: LR has a yoga room where guests can relax their mind and body. Unwind and revitalize yourself with yoga. The room is fully air-conditioned and can be reserved ahead.
Banquet Hall: Lalco Residency hosts many weddings every year with a variety of rooms and areas for different functions. F&B service can also be included with any wedding package.

Our Hotel Services (home)
In-House Restaurant: Lalco Cafe is one of the highest rated restaurants in Andheri. We serve Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner in our Restaurant, Room Service and Package Deals.
Housekeeping Services: Our housekeeping staff is available to our guests 24/7. We provide daily housekeeping services for each apartment.
Business Services: LR offers special deals on reserving our conference rooms, catering options, business event planning including meal preparation and many other business and exhibition related services.
On-Site ATM Services: Lalco Residency has an HDFC Banking branch within the complex. The bank is open during standard banking hours and makes life much easier for our business and executive travellers. It is a full bank branch with currency exchange, ATM and many other facilities.
Chauffeur Driven Cars: Guests can book LR’s chauffeur driven cars either for a specific amount of time or from point to point. We are happy to arrange services in either a large or small car based on your needs.

About Us
About Lalco Residency Corporate Serviced Apartments in Mumbai
Lalco Residency offers 5-star hotel-like amenities. Unwind in our yoga room and swimming pool. Stay fit with our gym, squash court, tennis court and more.
Affordable Luxury in Suburban Mumbai.
At Lalco Residency, we redefine the concept of a "home away from home." Our serviced apartments in Mumbai offer the perfect blend of 5-star hotel services and the comfort of your own home. Whether you are visiting us on business, a family vacation, an extended stay, or for any other reason our dedicated 24/7 team is committed to making your stay exceptional.
66 Spacious Apartments
24/7 Concierge Service
Lalco Cafe- In-House Restaurant
Large Swimming Pool & Gym
“Our mission is to provide guests with an affordable alternative to the expensive hotels of India’s largest metropolis while maintaining the comfort, space and luxury of a private residence with 5-Star amenities.”
Haresh Khiamal, Director of Lalco Residency
Serving Our Guests Since 2010
At Lalco Residency we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating every guest we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us or stay with us, we believe our purpose is to create an impression that will stay with you for a lifetime. We believe that life is richer when we truly connect with the people and the world around us. Lalco Residency has also consistently maintained a higher rating on Google, Booking.com and Expedia.com when compared to any serviced apartment or hotel in its class.
Our Standard & Values
1. Award-Winning Service — Lalco Residency owes its success and awards to its dedicated team. Every member works together to provide the best possible service. LR encourages growth by promoting from within and supporting economic progress for staff. Our physical space reflects our service quality and team skill.
2. Continued Improvement — We are always improving and learning from feedback from our guests on how we can make every stay more enjoyable and more convenient. We have recently upgraded our Living Room televisions to smart televisions to ensure guests can enjoy any of their own streaming platforms easily in the comfort of their apartment.
3. Statement Of Values — Lalco Residency strives to be an outstanding member of the community. We prioritize local purchasing and giving back. We have recently teamed up with local artists and craftspeople to upgrade and renovate several of our apartments.
4. V. K. Lalco Group — Lalco Residency was V. K. Lalco Group’s first venture into the hospitality sector. Founded in 1958, the group has been at the forefront of Mumbai’s real estate development. It has built over 40 buildings and is one of the largest landowners in Mumbai.

Kitchen article (1 June 2025)
Experience Culinary Freedom: Fully Equipped Kitchens At Lalco Residency
At Lalco Residency, we understand that a truly comfortable stay goes beyond luxurious rooms and modern amenities. One of the standout features of our serviced apartments is the fully equipped kitchen, designed to provide guests with the convenience and flexibility of preparing their own meals-just like at home.
1. Full Size Refrigerator and Freezer for Fresh Storage — Every apartment at Lalco Residency is equipped with a high-quality refrigerator to keep your ingredients fresh. Whether you’re storing groceries for a long stay or cooling drinks for a relaxing evening, our refrigerators offer ample space and modern efficiency. In most hotels all you get is a small mini fridge that barely has enough room for the items the hotel has already put there. At Lalco Residency you get a full size refrigerator and a full size freezer so you can store your food and beverage items as you please.
2. Versatile Cooking on a Stove or with an OTG (Oven Toaster Griller) — In every Kitchen, Lalco Residency provides its guests with safe and convenient ways to cook and heat up food. Prepare your meals the traditional way with our user-friendly induction stove. Whether you prefer a quick stir-fry or a slow-cooked meal, the induction provides precise control over your cooking process. If you you want to prepare your favorite dishes on a stove or bake a cake or toast some bread, at Lalco Residency it’s incredibly easy. We provide induction stove cook tops in every kitchen and OTGs are available on request for those who wish to bake or need the use of an Oven, Griller or Toaster.
3. Water Purifier for Safe Drinking Water — Health and safety are our top priorities. Each kitchen is equipped with a modern water purifier, ensuring you always have access to clean and safe drinking water throughout your stay.
4. Complete Set of Cookware and Utensils — Our kitchens are thoughtfully stocked with a complete set of cookware and utensils, including pots, pans, knives, cutlery, dishes, and glassware. Whether you’re making a quick breakfast or preparing a lavish dinner, you’ll find all the tools necessary to cook to your heart’s content.
5. Ideal for Long Stays and Health-Conscious Travelers — For guests on extended stays or those who prefer to maintain their dietary routines, having a fully equipped kitchen is invaluable. You can prepare nutritious meals at your own pace, avoiding the hassle and expense of dining out for every meal.
6. Grocery Shopping Made Easy — Located in the bustling area of Andheri East, Lalco Residency is conveniently close to various supermarkets and local shops. This accessibility makes it easy for guests to buy fresh produce and ingredients, enhancing the convenience of having a fully equipped kitchen. Lalco Residency also has an inhouse grocery store for guests to buy groceries and essentials.
7. Safe and Hygienic Cooking Environment — We maintain the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene. Every kitchen is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized before your arrival, ensuring a safe and welcoming environment for your culinary activities.
The fully equipped kitchens at Lalco Residency provide guests with the freedom to cook their own meals, maintain their dietary preferences, and enjoy a home-like experience. Whether you’re staying for a few days or several months, our kitchens are designed to enhance your comfort and convenience.
Lalco Cafe: A Convenient Alternative — If you prefer not to cook, you can always indulge in delicious meals at Lalco Cafe, our in-house multi-cuisine restaurant. Offering a diverse menu to suit all tastes, Lalco Cafe provides a convenient dining option for our guests who wish to relax and enjoy professionally prepared dishes.

All the Services of a Hotel — Guests have complimentary access to high-speed internet and cable television in every apartment. LR serves a Buffet Breakfast every morning with fresh Indian and Continental options. We offer many rate options that include our buffet breakfast at a marginal cost. Please contact our Sales Team for the best rates for your stay. Our dedicated 24/7 onsite management and staff are there to assist you with anything you may need. All LR guests receive complimentary access to our entire Health Club, which includes a Gym, a Swimming Pool, a Badminton Court, a Squash Court, a Yoga Room, and many other activities. LR offers what we like to call, hotel apartments in Mumbai, rather than just an apartment or a hotel. Like a hotel, if you want Room Service or Laundry Services, we offer them, but at a much lower cost than your standard hotel. Like an apartment, if you want to cook for yourself or do your own laundry, we provide you with the facilities and appliances to do so. If you’re looking for a Swimming Pool, we’ve got two, something many hotels have, but we also have a Squash Court and a Badminton Court.
Business Friendly Environment — LR’s conveniently located service apartments near Mumbai airport provide guests with easy access to both of Mumbai’s airport terminals and prime commercial and business centres. Bandra Kurla Complex, MIDC Commercial Belt, Powai, Seepz, Filmcity, Aarey Milk Colony and the Bombay Convention & Exhibition Centre (NESCO), the largest exhibition centre in India, are all just minutes away. The standard hotels near Bombay Exhibition Center can’t compare to the affordable luxury offered at Lalco Residency’s fully serviced apartments in Andheri East. If guests do need to go any further, chauffeur-driven dedicated LR cars are available at a very convenient cost. Lalco Residency takes pride in its highly efficient onsite security which operates 24/7 and onsite management staff that can attend to the needs of the guests anytime.
Comfort and Style — All of LR’s service apartments in Mumbai are decorated with imported, high-quality, stylish furniture and equipped with the latest technology. At LR, guests can cook for themselves in their own kitchen making LR’s executive homes serviced apartment similar to hotel apartments in Mumbai. LR provides the kitchen appliances you would need to make almost any home-cooked meal including a refrigerator, a microwave, a stove, a set of pots and pans, a set of utensils, and more than enough cutlery and plates. Our standard internet speeds are over 8 MBPS and we offer even faster speeds at relatively low costs. All of our apartments have Dining Tables and Living Rooms that seat at least 6 people, so they are perfect for small to medium-size meetings. For larger or more corporate meetings, we offer conference room spaces and separate meeting areas.
Group & Corporate Stays — We offer apartments from one to six bedrooms that can fit between two and ten people. The larger the apartment and the more people, the more affordable the stay becomes on a per person and per room basis. For families with small children, outdoor play areas and well-equipped playgrounds are also accessible. For families with large children, our Club House offers a wide variety of activities from Badminton and Squash to Table Tennis (known as TT in India) and Pool. With sumptuous food and customized menu, living in service apartments in Mumbai for 1 month can be a homey, delightful, and truly memorable experience.
Why Choose Lalco Residency Over a Hotel? — It is easy and convenient to book a reservation or inquire about short-term apartments in Mumbai. Lalco Residency has a highly efficient sales team that can properly address guests’ queries and various concerns about the accommodations. Questions about short-term and long-term stays are addressed professionally. Lalco Residency also offers 24-hour assistance and security services to its guests and occupants. It has the right amenities to accommodate conferences and business meetings such as function halls, conference rooms that can accommodate as much as 50 persons, formal and informal meeting rooms, and audio-visual devices. It also offers facilities that can conveniently mix pleasure with business such as a billiard hall, a tennis court, a squash court, and a swimming pool.
Check-in & Check-out Policies — Standard Check-in: 2:00 PM. Standard Check-out: 12:00 PM. Early Check-in: Guests must request an early check-in at least 24 hours in advance of their scheduled check-in time. If no such request is made, guests may only check-in early if a room is available. Late Check-out: Guests must request a late check-out at least 24 hours in advance of their scheduled check-out time. If no such request is made, any late check-out is a full days charge. A late check-out between 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM will incur a ½ night charge if an apartment is available.
Payment Policies — All guests must pay all room dues prior to check-in. The preferred method of payment for all guests is through a Credit Card, but LR does accept payments in various other forms. LR does not accept cash as payment for room dues unless approval is pre-checked.
Reservations & Deposit Policy — A guaranteed reservation assures you of a room even if you check-in after 6:00 PM. If a room is not available, we will arrange another accommodation at our expense. All reservations made through any website must be guaranteed by a major Credit Card. Certain reservations may require a deposit or hold to be placed on a guest's credit card. Please note that children above 5 years of age will be considered as full occupants. Cancellation and Prepayment Policies: Cancellation policies may vary depending on the rate or dates of your reservation.

Hotel Services | Housekeeping, Chauffeur, Business & More at Lalco Residency
At LR, you get all of the services of the best hotels in Andheri with all of the comfort of your own home. One of the best things about a serviced apartment is the amount of money you can save. When you are staying at a first class serviced apartment like LR, the options are endless. You are not stuck paying the high prices of standard hotels. You have the option to do your own laundry, or send it out to be pressed, folded or even dry cleaned. You have the option to cook your own food in a full sized fully functioning kitchen, or you can order in from our dining options. You have the option of bringing your own car and parking it free of cost, or using one of our chauffeur driven cars. You can choose to connect an unlimited number of devices to your apartments high speed internet connection. You can even choose what temperature to set in each room as each location has it's own individual AC control.
All service apartments at LR are decorated with imported high-quality stylish furniture and equipped with the latest technology. All of our serviced apartments in Andheri (E), Mumbai, have air-conditioners, flat screen televisions and Wi-Fi access with free internet in every room.
Lalco Residency is the perfect home away from home for short or long stays in Mumbai. We offer an unmatched living experience and have been rated the #1 Service Apartments in Andheri East by TripAdvisor multiple years in a row. We are the top rated serviced apartment/hotel near Mumbai Exhibition Center, Goregaon and Mumbai Airport.
In-House Restaurant — Lalco Cafe is one of the highest rated restaurants in Andheri. We serve Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner in our Restaurant, Room Service and Package Deals.
Housekeeping Services — Our housekeeping staff is available to our guests 24/7. We provide daily housekeeping services for each apartment, the same way as any other hotels in Andheri East or Mumbai Hotel.
Dry Cleaning Services — If guests need dry cleaning services or prefer to have the ironing of clothes sent out, we can arrange those services on a daily basis that can be completed within 24 hours.
Concierge Services — Our 24/7 on-site team is available to assist guests with all their needs, whether that is reserving transportation, a restaurant or assisting with travel or tour arrangements.
Business Services — LR offers special deals on reserving our conference rooms, catering options, business event planning including meal preparation and many other business and exhibition related services.
Internet Services — Lalco Residency provides complimentary high speed internet access to all of its guests. We have faster speeds available at an additional cost, but most guests are happy with the free internet that comes with your apartment.
On-Site ATM Services — Lalco Residency has an HDFC Banking branch within the complex. The bank is open during standard banking hours and makes life much easier for our business and executive travellers. It is a full bank branch with currency exchange, ATM and many other facilities.
Chauffeur Driven Cars — Guests can book LR’s chauffeur driven cars either for a specific amount of time or from point to point.
Airport Transfers — Lalco Residency offers airport transfers to and from Mumbai’s airport terminals for a flat fee for guests. We are one of the hotels near Mumbai Exhibition Center Goregaon. Being one of the closest serviced apartments or Hotels near NESCO Mumbai, we also offer car services to and from exhibitions.
